text: Which Schwann-cell-specific genes (single-cell) have no detectable mRNA in the cerebral cortex and none in the cerebellum?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Schwann cells / Cell type enriched AND Brain region category (RNA): Cerebral cortex / Not detected AND Brain region category (RNA): Cerebellum / Not detected
understanding: The user is querying for human genes that show Schwann-cell specificity based on single-cell RNA sequencing data, and have no detectable mRNA expression in both the cerebral cortex and cerebellum brain regions.

requirements.why: I chose 'Cell type category (scRNA)' because it defines RNA specificity across 81 single cell types (including Schwann cells), whereas 'Cell type enrichment (RNA)' is tissue-based bulk/enrichment.

requirements.why: I chose 'Brain region category (RNA)' over mouse or pig fields because human data is standard, and over IHC because mRNA detection/category per brain region is tracked via this field.
